purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian fiscal/tax document management - deletion of duplicate EFD168/EFD169 stock movement records (Nota Fiscal items) from a distribution/retail system (CDD Oeste, GEO SPC), involving ICMS, IPI tax fields
purpose.summary: Batch/web program PWPA6046 that deletes duplicate records from EFD168 (Nota Fiscal) and EFD169 (Nota Fiscal items/stock entries) tables that were incorrectly double-posted by program PWPE0248 on 22/06/2012. It generates a CSV log file of deleted records and supports a diagnostic mode. The program uses a CGI/web form interface with session validation.

notable_features: external-form section with identified-by clauses (CGI web interface)
COPY statements with REPLACING for file/record definitions (14 copies)
CSV log file generation with semicolon delimiters
Brazilian fiscal tax fields: ICMS, IPI, ICMS-ST, ICMS-Frete
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars (701 total lines); procedure division is only partially visible. The program appears to be part of a larger Brazilian ERP/distribution system (likely Totvs/RM or similar). The 'online-cics' program_type is approximate - this is actually a CGI web program using GnuCOBOL's web/CGI framework, not CICS. No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL present. File decoded with latin-1 due to Portuguese characters (e.g., 'Inválido').
